programme.desc: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls high school, is stuck with a baby that isnt his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching, an uptight teacher in the same school.

programme.title: Clan Feuds
programme.desc: Tie Zhong Tang, adopted son of Da Chi Men leader Yun Yi, is hunted by rival Situ Xiao, who seeks the clans hidden treasure. To uncover its secrets, Tie journeys to Changchun Island to find the legendary Ri Hou. Instead, he finds Ri Hou dead and discovers the clans founder, Ye Di Tie Yi, is his real father.

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple. The young couple faces the threat of separation due to her familys objection, so Hongs maid secretly helps to arrange their rendezvous in the West Chamber!

programme.title: Judgement of an Assassin
programme.desc: An evil clan plans a discord so as to dominate the martial arts world. Their masked assassins massacre another clan and one of the assassins is arrested and brought to trial at a tribunal of all the clans. What judgement will they make and can they uncover the truth?

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperors death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: Twin Blades Of Doom
programme.desc: A retired martial artist is forced to return with a vengeance after his family and friends are murdered by the evil Ghost Gang. He decides to challenge the gangs leader to a deadly duel so as to take revenge. Can he defeat the ruthless leader in the end?

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: Crazy Nuts Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: A roadside bandit and a traveling gambler team up to make money from gambling. In a successful attempt to steal a huge amount of money from a warlords home, they encounter revolutionists who seek their help to fund the reform campaign. Will the two help the revolutionists cause with the stolen money?

programme.title: Black Magic
programme.desc: Hsu Lo is up against an evil black magic practitioner San Kan Mi, who wants to place a death spell on him and a love spell on his fiancee Wang Chu Ying. Fortunately, Wangs friends manage to find another veteran witch doctor to take on the evil San. This bone-chilling tale of good versus evil races to a heart-stopping ending.

programme.title: Murderer Pursues
programme.desc: Wang Chung was a valued actor long before he became a director, but as a filmmaker, he helped create some of the most interesting thrillers Shaw Brothers ever released - including this fascinating crime saga of a Sino-Vietnamese crime gang. Danny Lee stars as a misunderstood refugee while Ray Lui plays a cop struggling against his own conscience to ensure that justice is upheld.

programme.title: Hell Has No Boundary
programme.desc: Cheng Chung Derek Yee and May Liu Hsueh-hua, a pair of lovers working on the police force, camp on an outlying island. Awakened by a strange sound, May goes out onto the beach where a violent frenzy grips her. After her return from leave, May insists Inspector Wang Yueh Hua in a bid to rescue some hostages. She shoots the thug under most peculiar circumstances. Then a series of tragedies occ

programme.title: Bloody Parrot
programme.desc: A swordsman is suspected of being the thief of a treasure sent to Emperor. Through his investigation, he is led on to the trail of the supernatural Bloody Parrot. Poisonous things happen including a demonic possession, witches casting poison spells and disgusting autopsies. Then a dead constable turns into a vampire!

programme.title: Roving Swordsman
programme.desc: An ambitious evil clan intends to rule the martial arts world. To achieve their goal, they must first steal a secret martial arts manuscript depicting how firearms can be produced. However, a supremely intelligent swordsman Shen Sheng Yi is protecting the manuscript and remains one step ahead of the evil clan.

programme.title: Crocodile River
programme.desc: This story has a Romeo and Juliet flavour. Two families who hate each other live across the opposite sides of a river filled with crocodiles and do not bother to have a bridge built. Their respective children meet in university and fall in love, but have to find ways to be together and resolve the hatred between their families.

programme.title: Iron Bodyguard
programme.desc: Wang Wu, the head of a security firm Iron Bodyguard, meets a scholar who is a member of the Reformists, a group of scholars pressing for social reform in China at the end of the Qing dynasty. The Emperor actually supports such reforms but not the Empress Dowager. She orders the Reformists to be arrested and Wang Wu gets drawn into the politics.

programme.title: The Lotus Lamp
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai plays both mother and son in this lavish fable about a goddess who falls in love with a mortal scholar Cheng Pei-pei in her debut role. Over two years in production, it was released on the first anniversary of Lindas tragic suicide.

programme.title: The Lady Assassin
programme.desc: Two feuding princes fight for the throne in the Qing Dynasty, causing many injuries and deaths to the commoners. Can the lady assassin who is drawn into this royal feud execute her assassination mission in time to help one of the princes secure the throne?

programme.title: The Mad Monk 1977
programme.desc: The movie consists of four stories of the Mad Monk helping others, from saving a mother and daughter from crumbling walls, to helping hawkers deal with bullies, recovering stolen money for a young man and punishing a devious court official and his son.

programme.title: The Eunuch
programme.desc: A year before Lo Wei directed Bruce Lee in Fist Of Fury, he wrote and co-starred in this tale of a treacherous devil who wants nothing less than supreme power...and doesnt care if he has to murder the Emperor and use his own daughter as a deadly dupe to get it.

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to attend school and falls in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After discovering her true identity, Shan Bo proposes marriage, only to learn that Ying Tai has been promised to another man. Forced apart, Shan Bo dies in despair. Devastated by the news, Ying Tai kills herself at his grave.

programme.title: Shadow Girl
programme.desc: A young swordswoman becomes invisible during the day and a monster at night after taking her grandmas pill. She ruined the wedding of a bandit chiefs daughter using her powers and is hunted down by them for revenge. Will she escape the hunt?

programme.title: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his peoples livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson. The young man was appointed as his bodyguard thereafter.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yues house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror her father is peeping at night and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kongs Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Lis daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her fathers debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her fathers wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A master gambler and his partner are recruited to investigate a Shanghai tycoon suspected of using his casino as a front for espionage. As they enter the high-stakes gambling world, they must outwit a dangerous opponent in a deadly game of skill and deception.

programme.title: The White Storm 2: Drug Lords
programme.desc: Drug lord Jizo joins forces with Mexican cartels, throwing Hong Kongs drug underworld into chaos. Determined to eradicate narcotics, billionaire Yu Shun Tin offers a HK100 million bounty on drug traffickers while concealing a dark bond with Jizo. As their shared past resurfaces, an explosive showdown becomes inevitable.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey2-Cinderella
programme.desc: Following the chaos unleashed by Pandoras Box, Joker is thrust through time and begins to awaken as the Monkey King, Sun Wukong. Torn between mortal emotions and divine destiny, he struggles to reconcile his love for Zixia Fairy with the responsibilities of his past.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tais father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Chengs friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Taos house became haunted. Years later, Master Taos descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his familys massacre years ago. During the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that has been planned for years and must use his skills as an assassin to face whatever comes his way.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Lets Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: Hong Kong detective Eddie dies while rescuing a mystical child during an international search for a human trafficking syndicate. Revived by the sacred Medallion, he gains extraordinary healing powers. However, when his ruthless nemesis also seizes its power, Eddie must storm a sinister castle and fight in a brutal battle for survival.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the schools stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world boxing champion Fai meets the passionate young fighter Qi in Macau and agrees to train him for an upcoming MMA tournament. As mentor and student push themselves to the limit, Fai rediscovers his love for fighting, regains his passion for life, and learns to cherish the people who matter most.

programme.title: Destinys Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girls heart.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfathers fortune with one condition he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: The legendary swordsman Li, entrusts the Green Destiny sword to a noble house for safekeeping. It is swiftly stolen by Yu, a young aristocrat of immense martial skills trained by an unscrupulous outlaw master. Recognising her talent, Li tries to guide her towards righteousness but ultimately leads them both to a tragic fate.

programme.title: The World Today
programme.desc: The core rolling news service of CGTN, with regular updates from Beijing, Washington, Nairobi and London, keep viewers up-to-date with all the worlds top stories as they happen. The World Today delivers breaking news, live events, in-depth reporting, expert analysis and sustained coverage.

programme.title: Dialogue
programme.desc: Dialogue is a prime time daily English talk show on CGTN. The 30-minute talk show covers a wide range of domestic and international topics, providing a balanced and critical perspective on current affairs and analysis within the framework of cross-cultural and multi-disciplinary comparisons.

programme.title: Global Business
programme.desc: The flagship business program of CGTNs English language service. The program offers in-depth analysis of the latest economic data, business trends and market moving policies, zooming in on how all this affects ordinary people.

programme.title: The Hub With Wang Guan
programme.desc: The Hub with Wang Guan covers hot-button geopolitical and economic issues, as well as interesting stories and trends in culture, education, technology and lifestyle. It aims to connect people, cultures and societies across the East and the West. The program features dynamic designs, fast pace and rich visuals to keep viewers engaged. It also makes use of trending topics online, while focusing on w

programme.title: 嚦咕嚦咕新年財 Fat Choi Spirit
programme.desc: 麻雀大俠德華天生喜愛打麻雀，以致多年前債台高築連累家庭，與弟弟天樂反目成仇此時天樂經濟上出現困難，德華決負起責任，並以麻雀治療患上老人痴呆症的母親，惟時遭舊女友詠琪百般糾纏，不勝其煩天樂堅持要靠自己，找工作時卻墮進麻雀老千采兒及青雲設下的陷阱，財產給洗劫一空德華為弟報仇，力戰青雲大勝時隆胸後的詠琪再次向德華示愛，但遭到拒絕，一怒之下詛咒德華一世摸爛牌不料詠琪下的咒語竟然生效，德華連場敗北，家財一賭而盡.

programme.title: 港生活．港享受 Dolce Vita 2022
programme.desc: 香港人生活多姿多采，港生活．港享受既呈献高贵典雅的品味生活，也会带来贴地亲民的优质享受节目结合多元化主题，每集探索不同范畴，并请来各行各业的精英分享成功之道.

programme.title: 六点半新闻报导 News At 18:30
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报导本地两岸及国际重要新闻.

programme.title: 新闻透视 社畜求生101 News Magazine 2026 Yes, Boss.
programme.desc: 新闻透视，每周专题报导多段香港以至国际的瞩目新闻，聚焦港人最关心的民生话题，并邀请各界人士学者专家，一同深入探讨个中来龙去脉.

programme.title: 东张西望 Scoop 2026
programme.desc: 东张西望星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮今日突发环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家.

programme.title: 香港系列之细间始终你好 Hong Kong: Never Too Small
programme.desc: 在时代浪潮的冲刷下，描绘着城市缩影的本地小店越来越少，它们却是建构城市的重要部份，也是无可取替的香港精神有见及此，贴地主持人阮兆祥引领观众一店一探秘，到访衣食住行四大民生领域的老字号新派小店，带出店铺的经营历史守业辛酸，娓娓道来几代人背后的故事，以有形小店留下无形回忆，呈现细间始终美好！.

programme.title: 冲游泰国11 Thai Rogered Sr.11
programme.desc: 第9集n波波享受按摩與牛奶浴新開幕一站式高空景點n冲哥波波介紹寵物友善酒店，池塘景觀房型是一大特色波波換裝到泳池戲水，再享受優質按摩與牛奶花瓣浴，舒適非常nn近年泰國校服體驗成為新興行程，冲哥帶波波到訪曼谷的校服一條街，並一同換上校服打卡，重拾中學時光nn2025年9月開幕的新景點位於近五十樓高空，設有藝術展區觀景平台及酒吧等，為旅客提供一站式休閒娛樂體驗nn精品店主打泰國特色產品，包括環保佛牌掛飾象神造型公仔擺設等，都是不錯的手信選擇.

programme.title: 奇情谷 Mystery Files
programme.desc: 爱情，是一门极其复杂的学问，而且周边充斥着不少可更改对爱情憧憬认知的环境因素，也会随着年龄变更网络文化骗案萌生等似怪不怪的原因，让社会衍生一段段光怪陆离打破三观的感情故事TVB Plus直播节目奇情谷，主持火火吴若希曾展望邀请各方人士艺人嘉宾情感专家，针对每集的主题，以独特的视角刁钻的问题，大尺度探讨感情疑难，同时欢迎观众透过直播聊天室语音来电，一同交流，拆解难题.

programme.title: 直播灵接触 You Are Not Alone Again
programme.desc: 直播灵接触载誉归来，第二季继续由鬼王梁思浩带领主持拍档黄耀英黄紫恩，以及小编黄滢仴汤之欣，为观众带来更多惊吓与惊喜每集锁定不同灵异主题，诚邀重量级嘉宾讲鬼故，揭开法科风俗与行业秘闻世界之大无奇不有，节目网罗各地阴讯，紫恩还会前赴韩国与台湾，一探当地异闻跟观众实时互动亦是灵接触亮点，团队紧贴直播.

programme.title: 晚间新闻 News Roundup
programme.desc: 报导香港两岸国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向.

programme.title: 八卦神探 Officer Geomancer
programme.desc: 薛丹仁李思捷是一名普通警员，但他非等闲之辈，因他在玄学上深得外公真传，每每在关键时刻，为许多奇案破解谜团，加上黑白通吃的好友梁醒裘梁烈唯作线人，其出众的作风常令上司车季菲万绮雯啧啧称奇，季菲拥有犯罪心理学专家资格，事事只凭理性，二人看似南辕北辙，但内里却因合作蕴酿了一种不能言语的默契，但季菲一副管家婆模样，工作以外只关心妹妹车季美杨诗敏和弟弟车季君郑俊弘的终身大事，当季美陷入醒裘和下属铁良芷朱晨丽的三角关系时，季菲情绪失控，幸得丹仁出手相助此际，城中发生连环失踪案，诱拐手法勾起了丹仁隐藏多年的往事，季菲不惜以身犯险，丹仁却算到.

programme.title: 丫鬟大联盟 Handmaidens United
programme.desc: 以兵部侍郎裘府丫鬟月盈黄心颖饰为首的六部丫鬟组成联盟，互通消息，一起赚钱月皎汤洛雯饰为筹钱给爱郎傅有为谢东闵饰上京赴考，卖身为婢月盈与月皎分别服侍大夫人官之姵郭少芸饰和二夫人上官云英张慧仪饰，各为其主，互相斗法！少爷裘其进洪永城饰与月盈情投意合，可惜遭父裘正郑子诚饰打压裘正犯事被降职，其进决心考取功名，重振家声兵部尚书霍奔潘志文饰之女霍燕贞刘思希饰也看上有为，多番引诱月盈月皎害怕情郎高中后失去对方，誓要他们状元梦碎两对恋人面临决裂之际，竟卷入卖国漩涡中.

programme.title: 他来自江湖 Justice Of Life, The
programme.desc: 明天原是黑道枭雄，因一次买卖令未婚妻意外身亡而大受打击，决洗心革面，经营联谊会为生明天与母亲舅父何英彪及表弟何鑫淼同住，英彪一直怀疑明天当年连累他被革离警队，故对他诸多单打，但明天并不介怀，鑫淼却视明天为偶像，两人情同手足，使英彪为之气结明天自未婚妻死后，本心如止水，不料邂逅余文骞及阮黛玉，感情生活泛起涟漪鑫淼为父误入歧途，牵涉入毒品买卖，明天为救鑫淼，联同警务督察旧友马世雄，与黑帮周旋.

programme.title: 使徒行者3 Line Walker: Bull Fight
programme.desc: 薛家强林峯饰完成三年卧底任务后，回港开设沐足店，继续收集情报刑事情报科总督察章纪孜黄智雯饰怀疑卓凯苗侨伟饰出狱后投入黑道，对他进行全面监视家强与卓凯卷入器官贩卖案，联同女卧底窦亚希蔡思贝饰及保安局调查官韦作荣马国明饰，合力捣破涉案集团保安局及后新设安全情报机构，并邀得徐天堂袁伟豪饰加入，接管刑事情报科的工作覃欢喜许绍雄饰逃过一死后，暗中调查某社团的秘密神秘社团原来由长兴已故龙头魏德信的弟弟魏德礼创立，他还设下布局，对家强卓凯等展开报复.

programme.title: 碧血盐枭 Sweetness in the Salt
programme.desc: 缉私营的聂致远马浚伟为剿灭盐枭窦家寨，故意扮作落难秀才博取盐枭之女窦胜雪杨怡的同情及收留，因而与窦胜雪建立了深厚的感情某天官府突然派兵剿寨，在混乱之中窦胜雪身受重伤并与聂致远及家人失散，幸得盐商胡坚郭峰之子胡亭轩黄浩然相救，并暂留胡府待找回双亲及聂致远，但窦胜雪却惊见父母的尸首被悬于城楼示众，而站在楼顶大义凛然地告诫众人不要贩卖私盐的官员，竟是令自己日夜牵肠挂肚的聂致远，窦胜雪柔肠寸断，且对聂致远有彻骨之恨......胡亭轩为助窦胜雪忘却不快，安排她在胡府经营的盐栈工作，而窦胜雪为报答胡亭轩救命之恩，不计劳苦为盐栈出心出力，那段日子令胡亭轩对窦胜雪由怜生爱，却碍于恶疾缠身，一直未敢表白，直至窦胜雪的二叔突然现身，暴露了窦胜雪的真正身份，胡亭轩为防家人报官竟向窦胜雪提亲......

programme.title: 丫鬟大联盟 Handmaidens United
programme.desc: 以兵部侍郎裘府丫鬟月盈黄心颖饰为首的六部丫鬟组成联盟，互通消息，一起赚钱月皎汤洛雯饰为筹钱给爱郎傅有为谢东闵饰上京赴考，卖身为婢月盈与月皎分别服侍大夫人官之姵郭少芸饰和二夫人上官云英张慧仪饰，各为其主，互相斗法！少爷裘其进洪永城饰与月盈情投意合，可惜遭父裘正郑子诚饰打压裘正犯事被降职，其进决心考取功名，重振家声兵部尚书霍奔潘志文饰之女霍燕贞刘思希饰也看上有为，多番引诱月盈月皎害怕情郎高中后失去对方，誓要他们状元梦碎两对恋人面临决裂之际，竟卷入卖国漩涡中.

programme.title: 他来自江湖 Justice Of Life, The
programme.desc: 明天原是黑道枭雄，因一次买卖令未婚妻意外身亡而大受打击，决洗心革面，经营联谊会为生明天与母亲舅父何英彪及表弟何鑫淼同住，英彪一直怀疑明天当年连累他被革离警队，故对他诸多单打，但明天并不介怀，鑫淼却视明天为偶像，两人情同手足，使英彪为之气结明天自未婚妻死后，本心如止水，不料邂逅余文骞及阮黛玉，感情生活泛起涟漪鑫淼为父误入歧途，牵涉入毒品买卖，明天为救鑫淼，联同警务督察旧友马世雄，与黑帮周旋.

programme.title: 使徒行者3 Line Walker: Bull Fight
programme.desc: 薛家强林峯饰完成三年卧底任务后，回港开设沐足店，继续收集情报刑事情报科总督察章纪孜黄智雯饰怀疑卓凯苗侨伟饰出狱后投入黑道，对他进行全面监视家强与卓凯卷入器官贩卖案，联同女卧底窦亚希蔡思贝饰及保安局调查官韦作荣马国明饰，合力捣破涉案集团保安局及后新设安全情报机构，并邀得徐天堂袁伟豪饰加入，接管刑事情报科的工作覃欢喜许绍雄饰逃过一死后，暗中调查某社团的秘密神秘社团原来由长兴已故龙头魏德信的弟弟魏德礼创立，他还设下布局，对家强卓凯等展开报复.

programme.title: 碧血盐枭 Sweetness in the Salt
programme.desc: 缉私营的聂致远马浚伟为剿灭盐枭窦家寨，故意扮作落难秀才博取盐枭之女窦胜雪杨怡的同情及收留，因而与窦胜雪建立了深厚的感情某天官府突然派兵剿寨，在混乱之中窦胜雪身受重伤并与聂致远及家人失散，幸得盐商胡坚郭峰之子胡亭轩黄浩然相救，并暂留胡府待找回双亲及聂致远，但窦胜雪却惊见父母的尸首被悬于城楼示众，而站在楼顶大义凛然地告诫众人不要贩卖私盐的官员，竟是令自己日夜牵肠挂肚的聂致远，窦胜雪柔肠寸断，且对聂致远有彻骨之恨......胡亭轩为助窦胜雪忘却不快，安排她在胡府经营的盐栈工作，而窦胜雪为报答胡亭轩救命之恩，不计劳苦为盐栈出心出力，那段日子令胡亭轩对窦胜雪由怜生爱，却碍于恶疾缠身，一直未敢表白，直至窦胜雪的二叔突然现身，暴露了窦胜雪的真正身份，胡亭轩为防家人报官竟向窦胜雪提亲......

programme.title: 丫鬟大联盟 Handmaidens United
programme.desc: 以兵部侍郎裘府丫鬟月盈黄心颖饰为首的六部丫鬟组成联盟，互通消息，一起赚钱月皎汤洛雯饰为筹钱给爱郎傅有为谢东闵饰上京赴考，卖身为婢月盈与月皎分别服侍大夫人官之姵郭少芸饰和二夫人上官云英张慧仪饰，各为其主，互相斗法！少爷裘其进洪永城饰与月盈情投意合，可惜遭父裘正郑子诚饰打压裘正犯事被降职，其进决心考取功名，重振家声兵部尚书霍奔潘志文饰之女霍燕贞刘思希饰也看上有为，多番引诱月盈月皎害怕情郎高中后失去对方，誓要他们状元梦碎两对恋人面临决裂之际，竟卷入卖国漩涡中.

programme.title: 他来自江湖 Justice Of Life, The
programme.desc: 明天原是黑道枭雄，因一次买卖令未婚妻意外身亡而大受打击，决洗心革面，经营联谊会为生明天与母亲舅父何英彪及表弟何鑫淼同住，英彪一直怀疑明天当年连累他被革离警队，故对他诸多单打，但明天并不介怀，鑫淼却视明天为偶像，两人情同手足，使英彪为之气结明天自未婚妻死后，本心如止水，不料邂逅余文骞及阮黛玉，感情生活泛起涟漪鑫淼为父误入歧途，牵涉入毒品买卖，明天为救鑫淼，联同警务督察旧友马世雄，与黑帮周旋.

programme.title: 使徒行者3 Line Walker: Bull Fight
programme.desc: 薛家强林峯饰完成三年卧底任务后，回港开设沐足店，继续收集情报刑事情报科总督察章纪孜黄智雯饰怀疑卓凯苗侨伟饰出狱后投入黑道，对他进行全面监视家强与卓凯卷入器官贩卖案，联同女卧底窦亚希蔡思贝饰及保安局调查官韦作荣马国明饰，合力捣破涉案集团保安局及后新设安全情报机构，并邀得徐天堂袁伟豪饰加入，接管刑事情报科的工作覃欢喜许绍雄饰逃过一死后，暗中调查某社团的秘密神秘社团原来由长兴已故龙头魏德信的弟弟魏德礼创立，他还设下布局，对家强卓凯等展开报复.

programme.title: 碧血盐枭 Sweetness in the Salt
programme.desc: 缉私营的聂致远马浚伟为剿灭盐枭窦家寨，故意扮作落难秀才博取盐枭之女窦胜雪杨怡的同情及收留，因而与窦胜雪建立了深厚的感情某天官府突然派兵剿寨，在混乱之中窦胜雪身受重伤并与聂致远及家人失散，幸得盐商胡坚郭峰之子胡亭轩黄浩然相救，并暂留胡府待找回双亲及聂致远，但窦胜雪却惊见父母的尸首被悬于城楼示众，而站在楼顶大义凛然地告诫众人不要贩卖私盐的官员，竟是令自己日夜牵肠挂肚的聂致远，窦胜雪柔肠寸断，且对聂致远有彻骨之恨......胡亭轩为助窦胜雪忘却不快，安排她在胡府经营的盐栈工作，而窦胜雪为报答胡亭轩救命之恩，不计劳苦为盐栈出心出力，那段日子令胡亭轩对窦胜雪由怜生爱，却碍于恶疾缠身，一直未敢表白，直至窦胜雪的二叔突然现身，暴露了窦胜雪的真正身份，胡亭轩为防家人报官竟向窦胜雪提亲......

programme.title: 那些我爱过的人 Life After Death
programme.desc: 七年前一宗严重车祸，破坏了两个家庭，改变了姜煜诚林文龙饰方乐汶黄翠如饰的人生七年后一次交通意外，让煜诚重遇乐汶，生活仍然有悲有喜乐汶与妹妹方书文连诗雅饰因身边人逐一离开而闹僵，没想到行为怪异的医生古希晨马贯东饰，却能直捣问题根源乐汶忙于照顾女儿朱幸而及继子朱嘉炳顾定轩饰，煜诚则一直未能了解独女姜子优苏皓儿饰的需要子优和嘉炳因缘走近，共同朋友莫宇谦李任燊饰竟为此段关系衍生更多问题，也令当年车祸真相渐渐浮现，众人亦要再次面临改变.

programme.title: 爱情食物链 Love As A Predatory Affair
programme.desc: 从事食品供应的鲁佳芳阮小仪样子平凡，身材矮小，年过三十仍欠缺恋爱经验，因一次苦瓜事件，帮助餐饮业才俊刘柏业陈智燊渡过难关，令这位高富帅欣赏到佳芳的内在美，并与她渐生情愫，佳芳的邻居兼好友高贵芬高海宁对此无法释怀，卖鱼出身的贵芬样貌身材皆属女神级数，千方百计也未能令柏业过电，却召来台湾担仔面继承者洪鱻金刚的青睐，洪鱻为亲近贵芬不惜自贬身价与佳芳她们同住劏房，贵芬得不到柏业唯有转战二叔刘利高郑子诚，但后来柏业承受不了外界对女友佳芳的负评，二人关系亮起红灯；当爱情再不是饮水饱，美丑优劣再无标准，男女同时成了猎人与猎物，血肉横飞的恋爱激战即将一发不可收拾.

programme.title: 逆天奇案2 Sinister Beings 2
programme.desc: O记干探许浚森陈展鹏饰沈韦力黄智贤饰奉命调查跨国罪案期间，得悉杀虎案幕后黑手魏子乐张颕康饰落网前，曾将神秘讯息发送至暗网，并汇出巨额加密货币不久有神秘人策动恐袭，浚森与韦力纵于天才教授唐冠峰方力申饰协助下破案，却惊觉子乐背后藏着更大阴谋！他们要竭力阻止子乐的同时，也遇到龙头棍风暴空屋藏白骨重犯越狱等奇案，能否一一扫除险阻？工作上面对的危机升级，感情亦遇挑战，浚森望跟前女友马颖思林夏薇饰复合，但困难重重令二人关系出现变量.

programme.title: 大酱园 Dripping Sauce, The
programme.desc: 万冠园是佛山酱油业百年老字号，大当家万启山吴岱融饰与夫人席德容龚慈恩饰坚持传男不传女，传内不传外的宗旨，可是一宗毒酱油事故，使他不得不答应让夏小满朱晨丽饰及叶细么龚嘉欣饰两女子加入，与其子万卓枫何广沛饰成为同期学徒三人与酱园小师傅华歌吴业坤饰建立了复杂的四角关系，又间接揭发了万家多个秘密，加上卓枫突然被掳走，人心惶惶酱园内，启山几个弟弟启石郑子诚饰启川陈嘉辉饰及启江徐荣饰酝酿分家，酱园外，专员高兆荣袁文杰饰也密谋夺取酱园财产，万冠园百年基业随时毁于一旦！.

programme.desc: Sembang selebriti merupakan rancangan bual bicara bersama selebriti yang menceritakan tentang pengalaman mereka di dalam dunia seni tanahair yang boleh dijadikan sumber inspirasi. Episod kali ini menampilkan Dina Nadzir sebagai selebriti jemputan.

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Sebelum melahirkan anak Antasya memohon maaf atas segala kesalahannya kepada Syarfan. Bayi mereka selamat dilahirkan dan dan Isabella telah menjadi penyeri di rumah. Najwan berdoa supaya dia dan Syafinaz turut menemui pengkahiran yang membahagiakan. Setelah beberapa tahun, kehadiran Hana mengejutkan mereka. Datin Jasmin telah dibebaskan dari penjara.

programme.title: Seribu Rindu
programme.desc: Maisarah dan Airel merancang masa depan bersama selepas mendapat tawaran kerja. Walau bagaimanapun, bapa Airel, Datuk Muiz, merancang secara rahsia untuk menjodohkan Airel dengan Damia tanpa pengetahuan mereka.

programme.title: Rojak
programme.desc: Dihoskan oleh Leaism, beliau akan melakukan aktiviti yang tidak pernah beliau cuba, mencuba makanan baharu, dan berkongsi pengetahuan am. Selain itu, terdapat juga segmen melibatkan respondan luar iaitu Cabaran dan juga Soalan Rawak.

programme.title: RONDA RODA

programme.title: Aroma Masak
programme.desc: Hani Fadzil selaku hos musim ini akan menyediakan 2 menu istimewa iaitu Ayan Nasak Paprik Lempeng Pisang sambil ditemani oleh artis jemputan, Shazia Rozaini.

programme.title: Misteri Mona Ku Serumu Kembali
programme.desc: Selepas Mona dilepaskan demi menyelamatkan anaknya, Anom dirawat di pusat psikiatri dan mengawal Mona sepenuhnya. Dakwaan pembunuhan rupanya halusinasi, menimbulkan persoalan tentang kebenaran sebenar di sebalik delusi Mona.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Oleh kerana kesihatan Aisyah tidak begitu baik, Iskandar memujuk Tengku Maria untuk menangguhkan majlis persandingan itu. Tengku Maria bersetuju dengan syarat dia mahu Iskandar menjaga Aisyah dengan sebaiknya. Perubahan Tengku Maria cukup di senangi oleh Tengku Yusuf, dia mula menjalinkan hubungan yang baik bersama keluarga baharu Aisyah dan Ros. Tengku Maria juga sanggup datang ke kampong halaman Aisyah dan memberi amaran kepada keluarga Mak Su Ainin supaya tidak lagi mencederakan Aisyah. Seperti karma, Iskandar kini menjaga Aisyah yang tidak sihat sama seperti yang pernah dilakukan oleh Aisyah kepadanya. Di sebalik rasa bahagia yang dirasakan oleh Iskandar di saat dia bersama dengan wanita yang di cintainya itu, dia juga merasa sakit di sebabkan sikap Aisyah yang kasar dan langsung tidak dapat menerima kehadirannya sebagai seorang suami yang sah. Aisyah dan Iskandar bertengkar dan Iskandar meluahkan segala yang dirasanya, Aisyah kecewa melihat Iskandar yang seakan sudah berputus asa. Aisyah juga sebenarnya berusaha keras untuk mengingati Iskandar namun sering kali dirinya gagal. Hatinya kuat mengatakan dia mencintai Iskandar meskipun kelakuannya menunjukkan dia seperti tidak menerima Iskandar. Aisyah mendapat jawapan yang jelas mengaoa hatinya benar-benar mencintai Iskandar sejak pertama kali mereka berjumpa selepas Aisyah hilang ingatan. Iskandar tidak keruan, dia puas berfikir. Malam itu, Iskandar berkemas dan meninggalkan Aisyah di dalam kondo itu.

programme.desc: Sepanjang berada di UK, Farah diasak rindu terhadap Lukman dan Zahin. Dia sibukkan diri dengan studi demi melupakan segala kemelut yang melanda di samping menjaga kandungannya yang makin membesar. Farah tidak tahu bahawa Lukman ditahan di lokap. Berita kematian Mama akibat heart attack bukan sahaja merentap jiwanya, malah meragut seluruh kebahagiaan keluarga. Lukman dihambat penyesalan tak berkesudahan. Zulkarnain ikat jamin dan menyelesaikan segala tuntutan syarikat untuk membebaskan Lukman. Liza dan Nazim seumpama tulang belakang yang sentiasa menyokong Farah di Manchester. Farah terkejut apabila Lukman tiba-tiba muncul di depan pintu apartment untuk memohon maaf kepadanya. Farah tidak sanggup berdepan dengan Lukman hingga menyebabkan mereka bertengkar. Tanpa sengaja, Farah tergelincir dan terjatuh di tangga hingga mengalami pendarahan.

programme.title: K-Love
programme.desc: Tish mendengar berita buruk daripada OB Gyne, dia terdorong untuk melamar teman lelaki lamanya manakala Sheila disingkirkan sebagai yang paling berjaya dalam kalangan rakan sekelas lamanya di sekolah menengah jadi dia memulakan perjalanannya untuk membuktikan dia masih mendapatnya. Jay sebaliknya pulang dari luar negara tetapi ada masalah, dia bergegas untuk keluar dari Manila ASAP.

programme.title: Jendela Hati
programme.desc: Farah dibawa pulang ke Malaysia setelah mengalami keguguran. Dia mengalami tekanan jiwa dan ada sindrom meroyan lantaran terlalu sedih dengan kehilangan tersebut. Dia seakan hilang siapa dirinya hingga meresahkan orang-orang di sekeliling. Namun, dia menafikan bahawa dirinya sakit. Musibah yang menimpa menyebabkan Farah semakin membenci Lukman meskipun Lukman sudah berusaha untuk berdamai dengannya. Joshua pula sanggup bertindak mencederakan Myra setelah Myra berterus terang dengan Lukman dan Budi mengenai apa sebenarnya yang berlaku. Nazim pulang ke kampung untuk urusan pernikahan adiknya. Farah bersungguh mahu mengikut Nazim pulang ke Manchester dan mendesak Lukman melepaskannya. Dia benar-benar tawar hati meskipun Lukman sudah insaf dan terus merayu agar Farah memberikan peluang kedua kepadanya.

programme.title: Cinta Dalam Sekam
programme.desc: Luka lama mula terubat apabila Laila menemui ketenangan di tempat yang tidak disangka-sangka, sementara satu pertemuan semula membongkar kebenaran yang selama ini tersembunyi. Ada yang memilih untuk meninggalkan masa lalu, namun ada yang masih bergelut menerima kehilangan.

programme.desc: Tingkah laku Uwan yang luar biasa semakin membimbangkan sehingga menggoncang emosi Alia. programme.title: Trendsetter
programme.desc: Trendsetter adalah rancangan mengenai trend fesyen dan gaya hidup. Kini kembali dalam musim terbaru bersama pengacara Zakuan Zainal. Episod kalini menampilkan Kedai Suza dalam segmen Usha Kedai, Gaya Kerjaya Intan Serah dan Bedah Kotak Aegis - SneakerLAH Wayang Loafers

programme.title: HURU HARA
programme.desc: Huru hara ini membincangkan tentang dunia hiburan, perjalanan kerjaya tetamu jemputan dan persembahan artis. Artis jemputan pada episod kali ini adalah Taqim Zaki, Ubai, Siti Hariesa dan F.Hiz featuring Qiff Dwic.

programme.title: Rembulan Tenggelam Di Wajahmu
programme.desc: Ray, seorang pemilik konglomerat berusia 60 tahun yang kaya-raya tetapi kesepian, kini sakit tenat dan terlantar di hospital menanti ajal. Semasa berada di ambang maut, seorang lelaki misteri berwajah samar muncul lalu membawanya mengembara secara spiritual ke masa lampau. Sambil mengimbau kembali detik kejayaan serta kedukaan pada zaman mudanya, Ray cuba mencari jawapan kepada lima persoalan besar tentang kehidupan, takdir, dan keadilan yang selama ini sering dipersoalkannya kepada Tuhan.

programme.title: Raya Emas: Salako Sacred Treasure
programme.desc: Jauh di dalam hutan Sarawak, sebuah legenda kuno tentang Raya Emas telah diwarisi turun-temurun. Tapi apabila mata-mata tamak mula mengarah kepadanya, satu perjalanan yang menguji iman dan keberanian bakal terungkai.

programme.title: Munafik 2
programme.desc: Dihantui oleh penglihatan menakutkan, seorang penyembuh muslim mendapati imannya diuji apabila membatu seorang perempuan yang terkurung didalam pertempuran, tubuh dan jiwa dengan seorang pemimpin yang jahat.

programme.title: Siku 12: Langkah Derhaka
programme.desc: Seorang bapa telah merahsiakan ilmu persilatan yang telah lama dipelajari daripada anaknya kerana sejarah hitam yang dilaluinya. Anaknya merupakan peninju Muay Thai dan atas desakan yang bertubi-tubi, bapa akhirnya mewariskan ilmu yang dikenali sebagai Jurus Siku 12 Langkah Derhaka kepada anaknya yang akan bertanding pada pertandingan terbuka Pendang Muay Thai 2021.

programme.title: Hani
programme.desc: Hani ialah seorang pelukis manga junior yang kembali ke Malaysia tetapi menghadapi masalah dengan tugasan terbarunya yang berkaitan dengan seorang patung berhantu.

programme.title: Ceroboh
programme.desc: Selepas dunia dilanda makhluk asing yang dikenali sebagai Penunggu Langityang mampu mengawal minda manusiaenam rakan berlindung di sebuah bangunan usang. Namun apabila salah seorang daripada mereka terdedah kepada mereka, rasa curiga dan paranoia mula menjangkiti kumpulan itu, membawa ancaman yang lebih membahayakan daripada serangan di luar.

programme.title: Repeaters
programme.desc: Tiga orang remaja berusia dua puluhan mendapati diri mereka berada dalam gelung masa yang mustahil, di mana setiap hari mereka terjaga pada hari yang sama menakutkan seperti hari sebelumnya.

programme.title: Black S2 EP7
programme.desc: Black menerima bantuan dalam kesnya daripada sumber yang tidak disangka-sangka dan dia hampir menemui tebusan. Keadaan semasa membuatkan Aisya menebus salahnya terhadap Black. Black tidak dapat lagi menafikan perasaannya terhadap Sofia dan dia berasa celaru dalam cara menghadapi takdir cinta mereka. programme.title: Beheading
programme.desc: Sebuah keluarga menjadi sasaran kemurkaan suatu entiti, memaksa mereka mempersembahkan korban kuno dengan mengahwinkan anak perempuan mereka dengan patung semangat leluhur yang tidak berkepala.

programme.title: Nak Dengar Cerita Hantu S2 EP2
programme.desc: Nadirah dan Farhan merupakan pasangan suami isteri yang sudah lama mendambakan cahaya mata. Antologi mengisahkan Lima pelajar universiti menemui Long Samad Que Haidar, penjaga sebuah rumah terpencil yang menceritakan kisah-kisah seram seantero nusantara.

programme.title: Nak Dengar Cerita Hantu S2 EP3
programme.desc: Mengisahkan sebuah keluarga yang terlepas bas terakhir untuk ke Genting selepas perjalanan mereka terganggu. Dalam keadaan terdesak, mereka menaiki sebuah bas lama tanpa logo yang muncul tepat jam 12 malam. Marisol yang peramah dan bersemangat mula mendekati Otto. Walaupun sering ditolak. Lambat laun, hubungan mereka berkembang menjadi persahabatan luar biasa. Melalui interaksi dengan jiran-jiran dan kenangan silam bersama isteri. Otto perlahan-lahan mula membuka hatinya semula. Dia mula membantu orang sekeliling, walaupun mulanya dengan berat hati.

programme.desc: Sekumpulan ahli payung terjun yang diketuai Kapten Hanafi dalam penerbangan untuk membuat penerjunan di Kuantan. Kapal terbang yang mereka naiki terlanggar seekor burung helang dan mengakibatkan pesawat itu bergegar. Dalam keadaan kelam kabut itu, seorang demi seorang penerjun melompat keluar dan mendarat di sebuah kawasan hutan. Di sana, mereka diganggu pelbagai peristiwa dan menganggap tempat itu berpuaka. programme.title: Dendam Dari Pusara
programme.desc: Dolah, seorang buruh kasar yang cacat kaki sejak kecil mempunyai ilmu luar biasa yang diperolehinya dengan memotong dagu si mati dijadikan minyak tetapi perlu mematuhi syarat ketat dengan memulangkan barang-barang yang diperolehi dalam tempoh seribu hari. . Dolah melakukan kerja ngeri ini dengan bantuan dua orang kawannya, tetapi pada suatu masa dia telah gagal memenuhi syarat tersebut dan bermacam kejadian telah berlaku selepas itu.

programme.title: Seri Dewi Malam
programme.desc: Cinta seorang isteri kepada suami yang sangat kuat membuatkannya ingin terus berjuang untuk hidup. Azri menemui jalan untuk berkomunikasi bersama isterinya, Seri yang jatuh koma. Dewi, seorang gadis buta yang memboleh membaca minda memutuskan untuk membantu Azri berhubung dengan Seri. Lama kelamaan, perasaan cinta mula muncul dan Azri harus membuat pilihan yang sukar.

programme.title: Perjanjian Syaitan
programme.desc: Tambun membunuh Tok Kadim, penghulu di sebuah kampung dan kemudiannya mengatakan bahawa Tok Kadim mati satu kemalangan. Selepas kejadian itu, Tambun dilantik menjadi ketua kampung yang baharu. Pada masa yang sama, Ribut, adik kepada Tambun yang berwajah hodoh ingin membalas dendam kepada Ujang kerana menolak cintanya dan memilih Seri sebagai teman. Ribut bersahabat dengan syaitan yang berjanji untuk menjadikannya seorang perempuan cantik. Sejak itulah Ribut berusaha untuk membalas dendam sehingga berlaku beberapa siri kematian yang penuh misteri.

Ayahanda Putera Hussein memberi tempoh selama 30 hari kepadanya untuk mencari bakal isteri. Putera Hussein menyamar sebagai rakyat biasa dan bertemu dengan seorang gadis bernama Noraini. Semakin hari, Pari semakin suntuk waktu yang Pari ada untuk mengahwini jejaka idamannya dan pulang ke dunia kayangan. Untuk memenangi hati Sarah dan keluarganya, Ali terpaksa berbohong dengan mengatakan dia juga merupakan seorang graduan Universiti Al-Azhar. Pada masa yang sama, Ribut, adik kepada Tambun yang berwajah hodoh ingin membalas dendam kepada Ujang kerana menolak cintanya dan memilih Seri sebagai teman. programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils 2021
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng played by Yang Youning, the leader of the Beggars Sect Duan Yu played by Bai Shu, the prince of Dali and Xu Zhu played by Zhang Tianyang, a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by love.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the caseolder adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. programme.title: Mutual Affection
programme.desc: Rich and talented scholar Sheung Liu Wai Hung was well-known to be a playboy. He like to fool around with his friend Por Lam Ka Tung. One day, they met the beautiful Dip Gigi Fu and Por was determined to win her hand. Sheung, therefore, helped Por by courting Dips maid Ngor Esther Kwan. Ngor disliked Sheung at first, but Sheung managed to impress her with his wit. When Sheung married Ngor, his nightmare started. Ngor interfered with everything he did and gradually he became henpecked. Then he had an affair with the lovely and gentle Cho Chan Mui Hing. Ngor was furious when she learnt about it and she told the Emperor. As a punishment, the Emperor ordered that Sheung could never see Ngor again

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show Sr.5
programme.desc: Li Jiading Master Ding, the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up Master Dings Kitchen, partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!

programme.title: Cause Of Death
programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan Hera Chan has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum Willie Wai. And ever since Chi-yan was a kid, she has aspired to join the Forensic Pathology Service. However, she is sidelined by her boss Dr. Lam Sum after starting her new job. Lam Sum and his ex-wife Ko Shuk-han Alice Wong, RCU Senior Inspector, cannot stand each other. Their paths cross again as their daughter Lam Suet-lui runs away from home. Chi-yan gains Lam Sums approval with her industrious work attitude and forms a bond with police officer Ko Chun Mark Ma. The three of them gradually become a well-coordinated crime-busting trio. After experiencing heartbreak and unemployment, Chi-yans buddy Sin Pui-ka Jinny Ng becomes a local news reporter. She and seasoned reporter Tsim Pak-yu Nicholas Yuen evolve from playful rivals to supportive partners. Just as Chi-yans career is progressing well, she hears the news of her good friend Pui-kas death. She is determined to uncover the truth and speak out for the deceased!

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. The Strongest Lifeline helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the Sanfu herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

However, undercover officer Ip Ho-tin Edwin Siu is sacrificed as he is injected with a colossal dose of dope, and he has since lost his feelings. Fast-forward ten years and Man Wah suffers from cancer and is given pardon and released from prison. He seemingly lives out the rest of his life by running some upstairs bookstore. Actually, he covertly asks his old love Cheung Lam Nancy Wu and a dumb guy called Tsui On-lok Matthew Ho to engage in online drug dealing. And he uses Cheung Lams status in the financial field for money laundering in the stock market. A missing police officer case sends shock waves across Hong Kong. Ho-tin is reassigned back to Narcotics Bureau to collaborate with his ex-girlfriend Ting Yeuk-ning Kelly Cheung. A war on drugs again breaks out

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demandwhat are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors.

programme.title: Cantoxicating! Sr.4
programme.desc: The Cantonese word gaigui ?? is vivid and profound, with many Hong Kong slang terms originating from various parts of Guangdong Province. Gaigui Ambassador Mayanne Mak has expanded her exploration to China, inviting Tang Chi-kin, Thye Cho-yee, and Hui Man-hin to join the Gaigui Guided Tour to delve into inland cities like Guangzhou, uncovering interesting anecdotes and origins. Professional Cantonese and historical experts will also appear, tracing origins and citing classical texts to reveal the charm of local Cantonese. Furthermore, Tang Chi-kin, who enjoys playing pranks, will transform into a single, nerdy man on the show, showcasing his pursuit of various goddesses and helping viewers understand the meanings of many slang terms and idioms.

programme.title: ChatSAT
programme.desc: It will do its utmost to gather the trendiest and latest information from around the world, covering everything from global events, medical encyclopedias, arts, and technology to daily life and trending online topics, sharing them with the audience every Saturday. By discussing everything under the sun and chatting about the hottest topics, Group friend listeners can easily stay up to date with global trends by following the program.

programme.title: Try It? Really? Sr.2
programme.desc: Elena Kong once again leads the team, joining forces with Cheung Chun-long, Chu Man-han, Ng Yip-kwan, and Tseng Zhan-wang to form the Try It Out Team, returning with acclaim after the hit first season and enthusiastic praise from netizens. This new in-depth exploration of Taiwan will see the team continue their relaxed, authentic, and down-to-earth style, guiding viewers deep into the islands heart. The team travels to Kaohsiung, Tainan, and Taipei, continuing the shows spirit by uncovering controversial shops with polarized online reviews, as well as hidden gems and little-known experiences tucked away in the citys corners. The team is committed to presenting the most genuine on-site feedback, aiming to create a practical travel guide to Taiwan that avoids pitfalls for viewers.

programme.title: A Date with Goddess Sr.2
programme.desc: The dating reality show A Date with Goddess is back with a bang, and the second seasons love battlefield is all upgraded! Golden Matchmaker Bob Lam is recruiting men from around the world to pair up goddesses Ho Pei-Chia, Kuo Pei-Wen, Chen Ruo-Si, Yu Ke-Cheng, and Yuen Ka-Man. The brave suitors face challenges like pressing the heart-fluttering light and a date at the Five Corners, each employing their own unique strategies to win over the goddesses. One-on-one intimate games ignite heart-pounding excitement, and a hidden goddess joins the fray, further intensifying the sparks More challenges await, and the brave suitors strive to reach the end and capture the goddesses hearts! In addition, the five goddesses from last season, along with celebrity guests, take turns becoming the Peanut Team, providing live coverage of the goddesses dates.

programme.title: Super Fun in Macau
programme.desc: Matthew Ho, along with members of the girl group MYNTSabrina Mendes,Carmen Ngai ,Ellyn Ngai ,Hilary Chong,Chelsea Mason and Skylar Lodeeply explored the streets and alleys of Macau, embarking on a fun-filled journey that combines innovative cuisine, century-old shops, unique crafts, and entertaining activities. Through competitions involving food preparation, puzzle challenges, photo opportunities, and historical research, the members will guide viewers to unlock hidden gems, charming shops, nostalgic establishments, and trendy landmarks throughout Macau. The event will also introduce Macaus unique leisure bus routes and attractions along the way, as well as the newly launched Macau History Exploration Guide, allowing everyone to experience the cultural charm of various historical sites.

programme.title: Fat Choi Spirit
programme.desc: Dehua, a mahjong master, has a lifelong passion for the game, which led to years of mounting debt and a falling out with his younger brother Tianle. Now, Tianle faces financial hardship, and Dehua decides to take responsibility, even using mahjong to treat his mothers Alzheimers. However, he is constantly harassed by his ex-girlfriend Yongqi. Tianle insists on relying on himself, but while looking for work, he falls into a trap set by mahjong cheats Caier and Qingyun, losing all his money. Dehua avenges his brother, defeating Qingyun decisively. Meanwhile, Yongqi, now with breast augmentation, confesses her love to Dehua again, but is rejected. In anger, she curses Dehua, wishing him a lifetime of bad luck in mahjong. Surprisingly, Yongqis curse works, and Dehua loses every game, gambling away all his wealth

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success.

programme.title: News At 18:30
programme.desc: Jade Channel reports important local, cross-strait, and international news every afternoon at 6:30.

programme.title: News Magazine 2026 Yes, Boss.
programme.desc: News Perspective is a weekly program featuring in-depth coverage of notable news stories from Hong Kong and around the world. It focuses on social issues that matter most to Hong Kong residents and invites people from various sectors, scholars, and experts to discuss and analyze the underlying causes and developments.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Hong Kong: Never Too Small
programme.desc: Amidst the ebb and flow of time, local shops that depict the microcosm of the city are becoming increasingly rare. Yet, they are a vital part of the citys structure and an irreplaceable embodiment of the Hong Kong spirit. With this in mind, the down-to-earth host, Louis Yuen, leads viewers on a shop-by-shop exploration, visiting time-honored and modern shops across four key areas of daily life: clothing, food, housing, and transportation. He reveals the shops operating history, the hardships of maintaining them, and the stories behind generations, using these tangible shops to preserve intangible memories and showcasing the enduring beauty of small spaces.

programme.title: Thai Rogered Sr.11
programme.desc: Thailand expert Hu Huichong once again leads the Tom Yum Family members to introduce the latest travel information in Bangkok, including glamorous massage parlors with perfect photo spots, newly opened shopping malls with sky parks, and buffet restaurants hailed as the pinnacle of Bangkok tourism. The content is truly rich in Thai elements. In addition, Bobo Huang Jingling continues to appear in this episode, giving away plenty of perks. She will accompany Hu Huichong to visit Ayutthaya, Khao Yai, and other areas around Bangkok, recommending popular holiday destinations for locals. Besides unboxing hotels, they will also visit pseudo-Japanese photo spots and hotel-attached childrens playgrounds, guaranteeing an authentic Thai experience.

programme.title: Mystery Files
programme.desc: Love is an extremely complex subject, surrounded by numerous environmental factors that can alter our dreams and understanding of romance. These factorsranging from changes in age and the rise of internet culture to the emergence of scams and other seemingly unusual reasonshave led to bizarre, worldview-shattering love stories in society. The TVB Plus live show Mystery Files hosted by Fire Lee, Jinny Ng, and Randal Tsang, invites people from all walks of life, celebrity guests, and relationship experts to discuss each episodes theme. With unique perspectives and thought-provoking questions, they boldly explore emotional dilemmas, while also welcoming viewers to join the conversation and solve problems together through the live chatroom and call-ins.

programme.title: You Are Not Alone Again
programme.desc: You Are Not Alone triumphantly returns! In its second season, the show is once again led by the King of Ghosts Leung Si Ho, together with co-hosts Wong Yiu Ying and Wong Chi Yan, as well as editors Wong Ying Yeuk and Tong Chi Yan, bringing audiences even more frights and surprises. Each episode focuses on a different supernatural theme, featuring heavyweight guests who share ghost stories and reveal the secrets of rituals and industry customs. With a world full of mysteries, the program gathers paranormal news from around the globe, and Chi Yan will travel to South Korea and Taiwan to explore local supernatural phenomena. Real-time interaction with the audience is also a highlight of Spirit Connection, with the team closely following live broadcasts,

programme.desc: The beauty of folklore is all around us in Taiwan, but we often overlook it and fail to appreciate and feel it. The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life.

programme.title: The Sound of Happiness
programme.desc: Wu is a senior police officer has always wanted a son to carry his family name and join the force. However, he and wife are bequeathed with four daughters! As a doting father, his chief objective is to help them find happiness in their marriages.

programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan dramatises folk tales, legends and local beliefs passed down through generations. Drawing on Taiwans rich cultural heritage, each story explores the lives, values and supernatural traditions of different communities.

programme.title: Taste of Life
programme.desc: Chu-Tsai Chao and his wife have five children. Having devoted his entire life to developing soy sauce products, Chu-Tsai sincerely hopes that one of his children will follow in his footsteps and take over the family business. However, he also respects their individual passions and aspirations. Because of their fathers dream of innovation, the lives of the Chao brothers are about to change.

programme.title: Venus Online
programme.desc: Venus Online is a vibrant lifestyle and beauty show featuring the latest in makeup, skincare, and fashion. Each episode shares practical tips and fun challenges that inspire confidence and celebrate personal style.

programme.title: The Ark of the World: Austronesian Taiwan 115
programme.desc: Broadcast live from Taitung, Taiwans 2026 National Day celebration brings together cultural performances and a spectacular fireworks display. Framed by the theme The Ark of the World: Austronesian Taiwan, the event celebrates the islands ocean heritage and shared national spirit. 2026

programme.title: Love, Now
programme.desc: Lan Shi De, who lost his first love in college, reunites with Yang Yi Ru in a foreign land. When he learns she has only six months to live, he decides to marry her and fulfill her dream wedding. Eight days later, she mysteriously disappears, and Shi De vows not to let true love slip away again.

programme.title: Limbo
programme.desc: Hong Kong is rocked by a series of brutal murders committed by a serial killer. Veteran detective Cham and rookie cop Will are assigned to the case. During the investigation, they encounter Wang Tao, who accidentally killed Chams wife. Seeking redemption, Wang assists them in tracking down the killer, but her involvement puts her in grave danger.

programme.title: The Unwavering Brotherhood
programme.desc: The revered elder of a triad gang faces succession uncertainty when his three trusted underlingsHua, Fei, and Guoare robbed while transporting gang money. Determined to redeem himself, Hua vows to track down the robbers. However, when Hua discovers that Fei and Guo are connected to the robbery, he must choose between loyalty and brotherhood.

programme.title: Love is the only Answer
programme.desc: At Bo and Cheong wedding reception, the projected was initially showing their journey of love, but suddenly a flash of a clip of Cheong and a sexy girl being intimate came up. Bo calmly ran up to the stage and announced that the wedding is cancelled. The incident rapidly became a hot topic on the internet. Within a year, back to being single again, Bo and the living life happily Cheong maintains a good relationship. One day, Cheong decided to play with love and took Bo to participate in a swinging party. The conservative Bo initially wanted to leave, but after being bribed by Cheong, she helpless and stayed. At the swinging party, the two encounter Kit and his wife Man Lai. The 4 of them develop a romantic and hot relationship... At another wedding reception, when the projector plays the groom and brides heartwarming clips, a flash of another clip that does not want to be seen comes up...

programme.title: My Indian Boyfriend
programme.desc: This is a love story between a Hong Kong girl and an Indian boy and is the first Bollywood movie to be made in Hong Kong. It encapsulates the conflicts caused by discrimination as well as differences in social-cultural background, lifestyle and family values between the races. The movie also combines tears, joy and laughter with song and dance.

programme.title: Detective Dee And Nine-storey Demon Building
programme.desc: A series of strange incidents happen at the Tangs demon building but Detective Dee finds no clue. Dee finds the master of the family suspicious when he speaks with him, and when the eldest daughter Miss Tang secretly informs Dee about Mr Tangs strange behavior and the fact that she is kept under surveillance, Dee vows to unveil the truth.

programme.title: A Gilded Game
programme.desc: Ambitious finance student Gao lands an internship as his friends family business prepares to go public in H.K. Under the mentorship of top analyst Zhang, his swift rise is soon undone by greed. After betraying Zhang for a rival, Gao puts his friends company in jeopardy. To redeem himself, he must seek help from Zhang to stop a hostile takeover.

programme.title: The Chinese Feast
programme.desc: Sun wants to start a new life as a chef in Canada and struggles to learn cooking skills from a restaurant owner, Au. While Sun will represent his restaurant to participate in a cooking competition, his skill is not good enough, and he has to seek help from a legendary master chef in order to win the ultimate challenge.

programme.title: Kung Fu Hustle
programme.desc: Mobster Sing aspires to join the Axe Gang. As he stumbles into a slum ruled by eccentric landlords that are kung fu masters in disguise, his actions cause the gang and the landlords to engage in an explosive kung fu battle

programme.title: Haunted Mountains: The Yellow Taboo
programme.desc: A photographer and his friends venture into a remote mountain for a photo shoot, unaware they have entered a forbidden area. As eerie incidents unfold, a mysterious boy in a yellow raincoat who leaps through the forest appears, leading them to uncover an ancient curse and terrifying secrets hidden deep within the mountain.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: The infamous Gang Trio is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million. When they discover the triad intends to seize the ransom and kill the child, they take the baby under their wing. Cornered by cops and hunted by gangsters, the three Rob-B-Hood must put the baby safely back in his cradle.

programme.title: One More Chance
programme.desc: A gambling-addicted Fai is entrusted by his ex-girlfriend to care for their autistic son. What begins as a chaotic father-son relationship gradually becomes a journey of mutual redemption, helping him rediscover himself. When he discovers his sons talent for running, Fai resolves to leave the past behind and support his son in pursuing his dreams.

programme.title: Hell Hole
programme.desc: The movie features three horror stories in different era: a pregnant woman haunted by a ghost sacrifices her life to save her baby a boy commits suicide after being bullied by four medical students and his spirit returns for revenge some company staff are haunted after they open a box of used clothes, releasing a more than 20-year resentment.

programme.title: The Vanished Murderer
programme.desc: Set in Northern China in 1932, inmate Fu Yuan escapes from prison by digging a tunnel with a silver spoon. Inspector Song Dong Lu is assigned to investigate the case. Following letters sent by Fu, Song travels to Hong City to uncover the mystery behind her disappearance, facing deeper conspiracies along the way.

programme.title: Triad
programme.desc: This is a story about the Hong Kong Triads. Ting William Chan. Cheung Derek Tsang and Dong Edward Chui are childhood friends who join a Triad together. After joining however, they discover that fame and fortune will ultimately break them apart as only one of them can become the leader of the gang.

programme.title: Lets Get Rich
programme.desc: The Jia family, a group of talented Taiwanese con artists, is recruited by a fraudster to expose a corrupt tech tycoons Ponzi scheme and to steal millions from him through a complex deception plan.

programme.title: Imprisoned 2: There Is No Escape From Fate
programme.desc: Hong Kong businessman Yu and his secretary travel abroad for business meetings. When the secretary is killed in their hotel, Yu is arrested. Despite pleading not guilty, Yu is imprisoned in a cruel multinational prison where the warden enjoys torturing prisoners, and he must find a way to escape from this dark and deadly prison to survive.

programme.title: Keep Rolling
programme.desc: Directorial debut of Man Lim Chung, who spent 3 years filming this documentary about the life and filmmaking philosophy of Ann Hui, one of Hong Kongs greatest filmmakers. It traces Huis life story and her 40-year careers ups and downs using film footages, candid conversations with Hui, and interviews with her collaborators, family and friends.

programme.title: Pavane For An Infant
programme.desc: In a conservative society, a baby hatch that never closes sparks fierce moral controversy and public backlash. Despite mounting criticism and pressure, Lai Sum, Fatimah, Kam Jie and Nuru remain steadfast in their mission to protect desperate mothers with nowhere else to turn, while offering abandoned newborns a fragile chance at life and hope.

programme.title: Back to the Past
programme.desc: After helping Ying Zheng unite China, Hong Siu Lung lives in seclusion for 20 years. However, peace is shattered when a group of time travellers returns with modern weapons to seize the Qin throne. Forced to reunite after decades apart, Hong Siu Lung and Ying Zheng must fight to defend the Qin dynasty and protect the fate of history itself.

programme.title: The Locksmith
programme.desc: Locksmith Master Shan suffers from dementia and passes on his skills to Hao Ren, who surpasses him. Detective Liu often seeks Hao Rens help and they become good friends. When Hao Ren reunites with an old friend one day, he accidentally unfolds the truth behind Shans wifes disappearance, leading to a chain of mysterious events.

programme.title: 72 Tenants of Prosperity
programme.desc: Ha Kung and Shek Kin are sworn brothers, but become sworn enemies in business and every aspect of life after Pinky, the girl they love, marries Ha Kung. It is only when the property owner of both their shops wants to terminate their tenancies forty years later, that they are able to resolve the rivalry.

programme.title: Sky on Fire
programme.desc: The chief security officer at a top-secret medical facility finds himself caught in an explosive battle when a young thief steals a groundbreaking medicine. After discovering the true origins of the medicine however, the officer must decide who he can trust to protect the cure from falling into the wrong hands and prevent an all-out war.

programme.title: Where The Wind Blows
programme.desc: Founded in the 70s, Hong Kongs ICAC is committed to fight corruption in the police force. Detectives Lui Lok and Nam Kong build a corruption system that creates conflicts between the triad and the police. When ICAC hunts down the two, their control finally comes to an end. Where the wind blows, Hong Kong is no longer what it used to be!

programme.title: Measure in Love
programme.desc: A massive earthquake splits the world into two regions where time flows at different speeds. During a medical relief mission, student An Qing meets Shu Zai, and an extraordinary bond begins. Yet with every reunion, he ages rapidly while she remains unchanged, forcing them to confront a love challenged by time, distance, and fate.

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires or fake ones!.

programme.title: The Duel
programme.desc: After knowing his brother has killed the head of a rival triad, Jie takes the blame and was hunted by killers. With the help of Rambler Nan, Jie finally killed his enemies, but then found out that Nan is the one who has killed his father.

programme.title: Five Elements Ninjas
programme.desc: After a Japanese samurai is defeated and commits seppuku, ninja lord Chin leads his clan to China for revenge. They challenge martial arts leader Yuan with the deadly Five Elements Ninja Formation, wiping out his unprepared disciples. The survivors must master the enemys techniques to break the formation and avenge their comrades.

programme.title: Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls high school, is stuck with a baby that isnt his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching, an uptight teacher in the same school.

programme.title: Clan Feuds
programme.desc: Tie Zhong Tang, adopted son of Da Chi Men leader Yun Yi, is hunted by rival Situ Xiao, who seeks the clans hidden treasure. To uncover its secrets, Tie journeys to Changchun Island to find the legendary Ri Hou. Instead, he finds Ri Hou dead and discovers the clans founder, Ye Di Tie Yi, is his real father.

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple. The young couple faces the threat of separation due to her familys objection, so Hongs maid secretly helps to arrange their rendezvous in the West Chamber!

programme.title: Judgement Of An Assassin
programme.desc: An evil clan plans a discord so as to dominate the martial arts world. Their masked assassins massacre another clan and one of the assassins is arrested and brought to trial at a tribunal of all the clans. What judgement will they make and can they uncover the truth?

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperors death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: Twin Blades Of Doom
programme.desc: A retired martial artist is forced to return with a vengeance after his family and friends are murdered by the evil Ghost Gang. He decides to challenge the gangs leader to a deadly duel so as to take revenge. Can he defeat the ruthless leader in the end?

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: Crazy Nuts Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: A roadside bandit and a traveling gambler team up to make money from gambling. In a successful attempt to steal a huge amount of money from a warlords home, they encounter revolutionists who seek their help to fund the reform campaign. Will the two help the revolutionists cause with the stolen money?

programme.title: Black Magic
programme.desc: Hsu Lo is up against an evil black magic practitioner San Kan Mi, who wants to place a death spell on him and a love spell on his fiance Wang Chu Ying. Fortunately, Wangs friends manage to find another veteran witch doctor to take on the evil San. This bone-chilling tale of good versus evil races to a heart-stopping ending.

programme.title: Murderer Pursues
programme.desc: Wang Chung was a valued actor long before he became a director, but as a filmmaker, he helped create some of the most interesting thrillers Shaw Brothers ever released - including this fascinating crime saga of a Sino-Vietnamese crime gang. Danny Lee stars as a misunderstood refugee while Ray Lui plays a cop struggling against his own conscience to ensure that justice is upheld.

programme.title: Hell Has No Boundary
programme.desc: Cheng Chung Derek Yee and May Liu Hsueh-hua, a pair of lovers working on the police force, camp on an outlying island. Awakened by a strange sound, May goes out onto the beach where a violent frenzy grips her. After her return from leave, May insists Inspector Wang Yueh Hua in a bid to rescue some hostages. She shoots the thug under most peculiar circumstances. Then a series of tragedies occur. Her two colleagues die mangled in a lift accident and Inspector Wang is injured at his desk by a snake. Wangs exorcist sister Hsia Ping, who performs rites for him, also dies in an accident. And so does a fortune-teller who refused to read Mays fortune.

programme.title: Bloody Parrot
programme.desc: A swordsman is suspected of being the thief of a treasure sent to Emperor. Through his investigation, he is led on to the trail of the supernatural Bloody Parrot. Poisonous things happen including a demonic possession, witches casting poison spells and disgusting autopsies. Then a dead constable turns into a vampire!

programme.title: Roving Swordsman
programme.desc: An ambitious evil clan intends to rule the martial arts world. To achieve their goal, they must first steal a secret martial arts manuscript depicting how firearms can be produced. However, a supremely intelligent swordsman Shen Sheng Yi is protecting the manuscript and remains one step ahead of the evil clan.

programme.title: Crocodile River
programme.desc: This story has a Romeo and Juliet flavour. Two families who hate each other live across the opposite sides of a river filled with crocodiles and do not bother to have a bridge built. Their respective children meet in university and fall in love, but have to find ways to be together and resolve the hatred between their families.

programme.title: Iron Bodyguard
programme.desc: Wang Wu, the head of a security firm Iron Bodyguard, meets a scholar who is a member of the Reformists, a group of scholars pressing for social reform in China at the end of the Qing dynasty. The Emperor actually supports such reforms but not the Empress Dowager. She orders the Reformists to be arrested and Wang Wu gets drawn into the politics.

programme.title: The Lotus Lamp
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai plays both mother and son in this lavish fable about a goddess who falls in love with a mortal scholar Cheng Pei-pei in her debut role. Over two years in production, it was released on the first anniversary of Lindas tragic suicide.

programme.title: The Lady Assassin
programme.desc: Two feuding princes fight for the throne in the Qing Dynasty, causing many injuries and deaths to the commoners. Can the lady assassin who is drawn into this royal feud execute her assassination mission in time to help one of the princes secure the throne?

programme.title: The Mad Monk 1977
programme.desc: The movie consists of four stories of the Mad Monk helping others, from saving a mother and daughter from crumbling walls, to helping hawkers deal with bullies, recovering stolen money for a young man and punishing a devious court official and his son.

programme.title: The Eunuch
programme.desc: A year before Lo Wei directed Bruce Lee in Fist Of Fury, he wrote and co-starred in this tale of a treacherous devil who wants nothing less than supreme power...and doesnt care if he has to murder the Emperor and use his own daughter as a deadly dupe to get it.

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to attend school and falls in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After discovering her true identity, Shan Bo proposes marriage, only to learn that Ying Tai has been promised to another man. Forced apart, Shan Bo dies in despair. Devastated by the news, Ying Tai kills herself at his grave.

programme.title: Shadow Girl
programme.desc: A young swordswoman becomes invisible during the day and a monster at night after taking her grandmas pill. She ruined the wedding of a bandit chiefs daughter using her powers and is hunted down by them for revenge. Will she escape the hunt?

programme.title: Kalavani 2
programme.desc: Arivazhagan files his candidature for the panchayat elections hoping to profit from the two competing parties, comprising of his uncle and his lady-loves father.

programme.title: Kottukali
programme.desc: A young woman rejects her arranged marriage for the man she loves from a lower caste. Her shocked family takes her to a seer, believing she is under a spell.

programme.title: Miss India
programme.desc: An aspiring Indian entrepreneur confronts disapproval, sexism and rivalry as she draws from culture to start a tea business.

programme.title: Trending
programme.desc: The film is about a vlogging couple that desperately does things to remain as the trending couple. The caption of the films poster - How far would you go - is suggestive of the same.

programme.title: Kaaviya Thalaivan
programme.desc: Two rival artists at Sivadas drama troupe compete in everything they do. While one of them goes on to become successful, the other fails in life.

programme.title: Cocktail
programme.desc: In a small town, three girls named Vaishali are murdered in one night by a Joker-like figure. Aspiring hero Vikram is entangled in the mystery: will he solve the case and save himself?

programme.title: Kabadadaari
programme.desc: A bored traffic cop uncovers chilling skeletons that shake his empty life, leading him to reconnect with a former investigator who once chased the same haunting case.

programme.title: Kolamaavu Kokila
programme.desc: A young girl in Tamil Nadu turns to the local drug gang to save her dying mother, risking danger, loyalty, and her own future dramatically today.

programme.title: Murder
programme.desc: After his beloved daughter elopes with an unworthy person, an emotional father chooses the hard path to make the corrections.

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.
